cards.context: You cannot attend but want to stay in the loop.
cards.subject: Re: Thursday sync — can’t make it
cards.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for the invite. I won’t be able to join Thursday’s sync, but I don’t want to hold things up.

Could you share the notes afterward? I’ll follow up on anything that needs my input.

Best,
Alex
cards.tip: Decline, offer an alternative, keep it short.

cards.context: It has been a week with no reply.
cards.subject: Quick nudge: proposal feedback
cards.body:
Hi Jordan,

Just floating this back to the top of your inbox — no rush, I know things are busy.

If it helps, I’m happy to jump on a 10-minute call instead of trading emails.

Thanks,
Alex
cards.tip: Assume good intent. Give an easy out.

cards.context: You need two more days to do it well.
cards.subject: Request: 2-day extension on the report
cards.body:
Hi Priya,

The report is coming together well, but I’d like two more days to get the analysis right rather than rush it.

Would Friday instead of Wednesday work? I can share a draft in the meantime.

Best,
Alex
cards.tip: State the ask, the reason, and a concrete new date.

cards.subject: Intro: Maya <> Chris
cards.body:
Hi both,

Maya, meet Chris — he leads design at Northwind and knows onboarding cold.
Chris, Maya is scaling our activation work and had great questions for you.

I’ll step back and let you two take it from here.

Cheers,
Alex
cards.tip: One line on each person, then get out of the way.
